title: Verify extracted SX1262.cs compiles under Renode and run test.resc smoke test
description: Follow-up from verified-close of project-LICHEN-636h / project-LICHEN-7m19 (2026-08-28). The extracted peripheral at .extraction/renode-lora-peripherals/peripherals/sx126x/SX1262.cs was member-level verified against lichen/boards/renode/peripherals/SX1262.cs (locks, readerThread, rxOneShot, latchedIrqFlags, loopback, SimHost/SimPort) and two parity fixes were applied (DispatchMessage try/catch in ReaderLoop; wasOneShot log capture). BUT the local Mac has NO C# compiler (dotnet/mono/mcs/csc all absent) and NO Renode installation, and the extraction contains no test.resc, so 'verify compilation' and 'test with test.resc + Renode' from epic 636h could NOT be executed on this host - only structural verification was possible. ACCEPTANCE: (1) In an environment with Renode (e.g. AWS EC2 fleet AMI or a Renode SDK install): load SX1262.cs (include in .resc or copy into Renode user peripherals), confirm it compiles/loads without errors. (2) Author a minimal test.resc + .repl for the extraction exercising: SPI GetIrqStatus (0x12), loopback SetTx->TxDone IRQ, SetRx one-shot -> RxDone after TX. (3) Record exact commands and exit codes in this issue.
